title: The Nine's message: surveillance of Earth, wars and nuclear weapons
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of The Nine's message: surveillance of Earth, wars and nuclear weapons, about 1952-1970s at Round Table Foundation, Maine, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
